_about: Which looping studio MP4 (output of tools/video_finish, with its .json report) plays each exercise, and how many COUNTED reps one loop shows. Counting follows the booklet: ex3 counts one when the second leg comes down (one loop = both legs = 1); ex5 counts each LEFT-foot landing. cycle_frames is worked out from the file and the report's 'loop xN'.

run._measured: 2026-11-28: footfall period 13 frames (raised-shoe autocorrelation on the studio render), loop 91 frames = 7 footfalls = 3.5 left-foot landings. An odd footfall count means the near/far legs swap at the loop joint; it is invisible from the side but worth fixing in the next run render (ask for an even number of strides).

scissor._measured: 2026-11-28: hop period about 0.54 s, loop 28 frames = 2 hops. This clip is a placeholder bounce, not a verified scissor exchange.

situp_headonly._note: Used instead of 'situp': the original source rises to a near-full sit-up; this salvage edit keeps the small head-and-shoulders curl (matches Orban's Chart 1 picture).
